purpose: Builds a deterministic sampling frame over an AML consent-order lookback's historical alert dispositions for independent-validator review, plus a reviewer workload allocation. Reuses the shipped art-458-attribute-sampling-plan kernel's compute() directly for the statistical core (sample size, deterministic interval selection over a caller-declared population hash) rather than reimplementing it -- no randomness, fully replayable by an independent reviewer from the same declared inputs. Adds only the AML-specific layer: labeling the frame as a disposition sample and deterministically fanning the selected indices out round-robin across a caller-declared reviewer roster. Deterministic only. Zero network, zero PII.
